Name: Adaptable Bee House
Author: flamingbanone
Description:
For those who want to know how exactly they work:
>Instead of detecting flowers and creating respective honey based on that over time, this processes any type of flower (as long as it has the tag "Flower") & [NEW] tree fruit 
> Processing time: [spoiler]Processing time is 1/2 the time of normal bee house (since the flower is consumed) [56h (2d 2h 40min)][/spoiler]
> Pricing: [spoiler]Pricing is the same as usual honey [2x(flowerBasePrice) + 100] for flowers, alternated for tree fruit [2x(fruitBasePrice) + 100][/spoiler]
> Crafting obtaining: [spoiler]Mail should be delivered whenever you ship at least 1 honey and have the farming level 3 (which is the level you obtain Bee House recipe, the recipe: 40 wood, 1 pine tar, 1 maple syrup, 1 iron bar)[/spoiler]
> Output: [spoiler]It is made that when processing higher quality items, there is a chance that more honey will be produced. (10% for silver, 25% for gold and 50% for iridium for 1 extra flavoured honey[/spoiler]

Anything should be easily configurable in config files, feel free to tweak the values to your desire.
